Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 29

“One sees this as a wonder, another speaks of it as a wonder, another hears of it as a wonder — and even having heard, no one truly knows it.”

An unusual pause. After many confident verses, Krishna admits the self mostly escapes those who study it. The honesty guards his teaching against being mistaken for something already mastered.
